transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

Honestly, Doctor, I've been feeling absolutely amazing, incredibly energetic, and just completely full of life! This fantastic high and burst of happiness has been going on for about a year and two months now. I just feel so unstoppable and happy almost all the time!
During this highly energetic period, have you ever experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things others couldn't, or holding very unusual beliefs?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices, see things that aren't there, or hold any unusual beliefs.
During these times of high energy, has it ever caused serious disruption in your daily life, work, or relationships, or have you ever needed to be hospitalized because of it?
I'm not really sure if it has caused any serious disruption in my daily life or work. I definitely haven't ever been hospitalized because of it, though.
Have you ever had periods in your life where you felt the exact opposite—such as feeling very down, empty, or losing interest in things you normally enjoy for at least two weeks?
No, I've never experienced anything like that at all. I don't get down or lose interest in things; I've just felt full of energy and really good. I can't even imagine feeling empty or sad like that.

Further assessment is needed to evaluate the severity, presence of psychotic features, and any history of depressive or psychotic episodes independent of mood symptoms.
